# Fish video tracking

AquaTrajectories separates three tasks that are often incorrectly conflated:

**Fish detection** identifies candidate boxes; **within-video tracking** assigns provisional camera-local IDs; **biological re-identification** requires independent evidence that a particular tracked body remains the same fish, especially across occlusions and views.

## From GoPro recordings to structured observations

<figure class="aqt-figure"><img src="../workflow.svg" alt="Video-to-track provenance workflow." loading="lazy"></figure>

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">The path is conceptual; detector performance requires independent fish-specific benchmarking.</p>

The optional runner `inst/python/aqt_track_video.py` accepts local videos with **user-supplied fish-trained YOLO weights**, uses PyAV frame decoding/PTS metadata, and runs YOLO/ByteTrack with persistent tracker state. Outputs include frame manifests, MOT boxes, species-class sidecars and SHA-256 provenance files.

**It does not train a fish detector.** It does not claim universal GoPro support, automatically label animal welfare, or guarantee stable fish identities.

## Input contracts

- Capture frame timestamps from the actual recording rather than assuming every camera runs at an exact constant FPS.
- Preserve camera, recording, frame and track scopes.
- Keep genuine acquired frames with **no fish detection** in the frame manifest.
- Treat detector class, confidence and bounding-box geometry as separately auditable data.
- Refuse invalid or ambiguous rows rather than silently extending a track across lost observations.

### Core entry points

[`aqt_frame_manifest()`](../reference/aqt_frame_manifest.html): validate camera-local frame times, dimensions and frame numbering.

[`aqt_import_mot()`](../reference/aqt_import_mot.html): import external MOTChallenge/ByteTrack-style 1-based frame and box data with exact PTS.

[`aqt_import_yolo()`](../reference/aqt_import_yolo.html) and [`aqt_import_idtracker()`](../reference/aqt_import_idtracker.html): import declared external tracking formats.

[`aqt_video_bundle_import()`](../reference/aqt_video_bundle_import.html): verify a coordinated four-file bundle and metadata consistency.

[`aqt_mot_support_audit()`](../reference/aqt_mot_support_audit.html): separate acquired but undetected frames from genuinely missing acquired frames.

## Labeling: what counts as reference truth?

A detector's own boxes are **not** independent ground truth. Sample and label frames before inspecting predictions, include verified empty frames and record reviewer disagreements. For identities, review the temporal fish assignment across events/occlusions, not merely frame-level boxes.

The package includes [`aqt_annotation_frame_plan()`](../reference/aqt_annotation_frame_plan.html), [`aqt_annotation_plan_audit()`](../reference/aqt_annotation_plan_audit.html), [`aqt_apply_identity_corrections()`](../reference/aqt_apply_identity_corrections.html) and [`aqt_video_bundle_benchmark()`](../reference/aqt_video_bundle_benchmark.html) for transparent evaluation.

## Example — import then validate

```r
# Camera PTS and MOT boxes are externally supplied, not guessed.
# Read the exact file schemas before calling these import functions:
?aqt_frame_manifest
?aqt_import_mot
?aqt_video_bundle_import
?aqt_video_bundle_benchmark
```

**Original protocols:** [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/PYAV_YOLO_BYTETRACK_RUNNER.md), [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/MOT_FRAME_PTS_INGESTION.md), [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/INDEPENDENT_VIDEO_BENCHMARK.md) and [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/PREDECLARED_VIDEO_ANNOTATION_SAMPLING.md).

## Practical safeguards

Direct reflections, floating food, surface bubbles, shadows, mixed species and fish overlap can create false detections or ID swaps. Quantify those cases separately with annotated challenge strata. Camera-local IDs are only identifiers assigned by a tracker; do not describe them as certified biological individual IDs.
